title: UI pass can write its renders to its run temp dir
lead: *Proposed.* A cloud UI pass may write files only under its own run temp dir (for rendered views), as a claude-local read-only role may write its progress note (adj 348). It still may not change the worktree.
findings_note: S241 (2026-11-16, run ork-20261116-015040-d93b): the UI pass (claude opus, read-only, plan mode) was denied two Writes to `~/.local/state/ork/runs/RUN/` and reported tool feedback: "plan mode allowed writing only a plan file, so renders/*.txt could not be produced".

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: *Proposed.* The UI pass prompt asks for rendered views to check layout; plan mode blocks every write but the plan file, so the pass reviews without them.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - `TestUIPassMayWriteOnlyItsTempDir`: a UI pass's args allow Write and Edit only under its run temp dir; a reviewer's args are unchanged.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `adj ask` the mechanism (an `Edit(DIR/**)` allow rule beside plan mode, or acceptEdits with a path rule) with `--ref` this slice; wait for the owner's answer.
2. Red test, then the args.
3. Docs: `docs/design.md`. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.

Owner decisions (2026-11-16): Which mechanism lets a cloud UI pass write its renders, and under which path? -> accept-edits: switch the UI pass to `--permission-mode acceptEdits`. Add path rules that deny `Edit`/`Write` outside TEMPDIR, so the worktree stays unwritable. [roles.ui-pass-write-mechanism].
